domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia returned HTTP 403, volza returned HTTP 403, and the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unreachable; Bing returned only irrelevant results for the query. No domestic supply record seen — this is an absence of accessible data, not a negative finding.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records from Tuticorin Sea (HS 07114000 gherkins in brine/acid, provisionally preserved) to Slovenia, Spain and Poland, Feb 2026 — this matches the declared HS 071140 and confirms the company is an active exporter, not merely a claimant. Declared HS 090421 (pepper) and 200570 (preserved olives) were NOT observed in the visible rows; only 5 of 200 records were visible, so those codes are unverified rather than contradicted — no HS correction is warranted on this evidence. Role appears to be manufacturer-exporter of processed gherkins (own packing in HM-HDPE barrels), though the free view does not prove ownership of processing capacity. Domestic (India) supply activity: no evidence found either way; GST turnover and export/revenue split are null — not public in accessible sources. No rejection grounds: entity is active and shipping.
